notes: Probes: nova.rs/robots.txt 200, permissive (only /admin/ and /api/v1/* disallowed; the /api/v1/articles/ JSON API is robots-disallowed so not used), names 4 sitemaps. sitemap.xml 200 = sitemapindex of 628 files incl. 628 sitemap_post_N.xml and 1 sitemap_news_1.xml. Route chosen: sitemap_post_N.xml files are strictly ordered by lastmod DESCENDING, 1000 urls each, ~5.5 days per file, so files 1-6 cover the whole 2026-09-25..2026-10-25 window (7 requests total, ~10 s run). Date: <lastmod> IS publication time, not edit time - verified on 4 articles across two files: lastmod matched page JSON-LD datePublished to the second (e.g. sitemap 2026-10-20T23:04:42+02:00 vs page 2026-10-20T21:04:42.360428+00:00; and 2026-10-26T07:31:16+01:00 vs 06:31:16.587618+00:00 where dateModified was already 6 min later), so lastmod tracks publish even after edits. Listed date = lastmod converted to UTC, which equals the page JSON-LD datePublished date exactly (0-day drift). The news sitemap (has news:publication_date) only reaches back ~2 days, so it cannot cover the window. Result: 5701 unique URLs, 31/31 days, min 115/day (09-30=195, 10-10=123, 10-20=211). Self-test: 4 random re-fetches all 200, 27-29k chars text, page date == listed date.
